description: Source code for thread management functions in Samsung's OpenMAX IL implementation, including thread creation, termination, cancellation, and sleep utilities.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_ThreadCreate
methods.description: Creates a new thread with specified function and argument, sets thread attributes, and handles errors.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_ThreadTerminate
methods.description: Joins and frees the thread handle, terminating the thread.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_ThreadCancle
methods.description: Cancels a thread by exiting and joining it, then frees the handle.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_TheadExit
methods.description: Exits the current thread with a specified value.

methods.name: SEC_OSAL_SleepMillisec
methods.description: Sleeps for the specified number of milliseconds.
